author: Drew Lanio, Andrew Koenig, Nathalie Touchet
title: Hickman softball wins its 10th game against Capital City
text:
Hickman softball defeated Capital City 11-9 in a back-and-forth contest that featured plenty of runs.
Capital City opened the game with four runs in the first inning, which Hickman quickly matched in the bottom frame thanks to a leadoff triple from senior Megan Schoeneberg and a two-run home run from sophomore Jersey Kessler.
